title: What Aesthetic Are You? 16 Viral Vibe Types
description: Asking "what aesthetic am I"? Answer 12 questions about your closet, your room and your mood to match one of 16 viral vibe types — Coquette, Mob Wife, Clean Girl, Dark Academia and more.

questions.text: It's Friday night and your friends are texting about plans. You...

options.text: Are out the door before the second text — a full house is where you wake up
Say yes only if it's small; a crowded room drains you by 10pm
Host the pre-drinks and end up running the whole night's itinerary
Politely ghost the group chat and light a candle for your own evening

questions.text: You put together an outfit you're obsessed with. You...

options.text: Need it seen — you compliment strangers' outfits and want yours noticed too
Wear it entirely for yourself; being stared at kind of ruins it
Suggest a group mirror pic before anyone even leaves
Take one quiet full-body selfie for your camera roll, never to be posted
Brunch with six people, then vintage shopping with whoever's free
Rearranging your room alone with a podcast, exactly on your own schedule
A spontaneous day trip you organized in the group chat last night
A long solitary walk, then a book and tea without a single notification

questions.text: When you're shopping, the piece that gets you is...

options.text: A classic — great fabric, timeless cut, you know exactly when you'll wear it
Something that makes you imagine an entire alter ego and life story
A better version of something you already wear constantly
A weird magical object you have no occasion for, and that's the point

questions.text: Your favorite kind of style inspiration is...

options.text: Real eras and real archives — fashion people actually wore decades ago
Completely invented worlds — fairy tales, fantasy films, imagined futures
Street-style photos of real outfits in real weather
Concept art and mood boards of worlds that don't exist yet

questions.text: Picture your perfect room. It's full of...

options.text: Things with a clear job: good lighting for tasks, real furniture that lasts
Things chosen purely for feeling — a lamp that exists just to glow like a spell
Organized shelves where you could find anything in the dark
Layers of whimsy: fairy lights, trinkets, corners that feel like a story

questions.text: When you get dressed in the morning, the first thing you consider is...

options.text: What your day actually involves — you have to move and not think about it
What mood you woke up in, even if it's the less practical choice
The weather, the walking, the function — comfort by calculation
Which version of yourself you feel like being today

questions.text: A friend is about to leave in an outfit you genuinely think is a disaster. You...

options.text: Tell her honestly now — one awkward minute beats photos she can't untag
Say she looks amazing; she's glowing tonight and that actually matters more
Give her one specific swap, framed as a styling upgrade, not a criticism
Let her have the night — confidence is the best thing she could wear

questions.text: Time for a wardrobe clear-out. You make decisions based on...

options.text: Use: if you haven't worn it in a year, it goes — no negotiation
Memory: you can feel the day tied to that piece and it stays
Cost-per-wear and whether it earns its hanger space
Whether it still makes you feel something when you hold it
Decided the night before; your closet is a capsule and mornings are calm
Pure improvisation, standing in front of the open closet at the last minute
A rotating schedule — you know Thursday's outfit by Tuesday
Three outfit changes deep and somehow always slightly late

questions.text: How do you actually feel about aesthetics? You...

options.text: Pick one and commit — a whole season in one coherent world
Change with the week — one era Monday, a different one by Friday
Curate every detail to match the point of view you chose
Blend whatever feels right in the moment, rules be damned

questions.text: When you travel, your trip is...

options.text: Mapped: reservations, opening hours, an itinerary you actually follow
A starting point and a backpack — you'll discover the best part unplanned
A spreadsheet your friends now just trust you for
Wandering until something pulls you in, with zero firm bookings

results.title: Coquette
results.description: Bows in your hair, lace on your sleeves, and an inner world richer than the entire outside one. You turned softness into a point of view — and the diary entries, love letters and cinematic daydreams? That's the real you nobody gets to read.

results.title: Clean Girl
results.description: Glassy skin, gold hoops, neutral everything, and the quiet warmth of someone who actually remembers everyone's birthday. You make 'put-together' look effortless — while somehow always carrying spare lip balm, a snack and a plan B for the group.

results.title: Old Money
results.description: No logos, heritage fabrics, a trench coat older than half your friends' trends. You don't chase fashion — you invest in what outlives it, which is exactly what makes you read as the most expensive person in any room.

results.title: Mob Wife
results.description: Big hair, bigger gold, red lip sharp enough to end a conversation. While everyone else was being tasteful and minimal, you walked in loud, unapologetic and having the most fun in the building — nobody tells you what's too much.

results.title: Dark Academia
results.description: Tweed, candle wax, half-finished essays and the belief that a library in autumn is the highest form of life. You romanticize knowledge so completely that you actually go and get it — the brooding is real, but so is the brain.

results.title: Cottagecore
results.description: Flour-dusted aprons, foraged flowers, a sourdough starter with a name. You're quietly building the gentle, handmade life the rest of us only save pictures of — and yes, your picnic really does look like that.

results.title: Y2K
results.description: Low-rise denim, metallic shine, butterfly clips and the energy of someone who came to be seen. You treat life like the early internet promised: shiny, optimistic, and one glittery accessory away from a good time.

results.title: Balletcore
results.description: Wrap ties, ribbon details, soft pink and a discipline you never announce. There's a quietly intense soul under all that grace — the gentle look is real, but so is the years-long devotion to the thing you love.

results.title: Goth
results.description: Black on black on black, a decades-deep subculture and zero interest in explaining it. While trends rise and die around you, you're off reading poetry, arguing philosophy and quietly outliving every single one of them.

results.title: Baddie
results.description: Full glam, sharp contour, sharper ambitions, and the unshakable belief that you're the main event. You don't wait to be picked or noticed — you walk in like the room was already yours, because your plans say it is.

results.title: Fairycore
results.description: Sheer wings, mushroom motifs, glitter on your cheeks for no occasion. You still believe the woods might be magic if you look soft enough — and your chaotic, sparkling enthusiasm makes everyone around you believe it too.

results.title: Grunge
results.description: Flannel, combat boots, undone hair and the calm conviction that polish is a scam. You don't perform your feelings or your style — you keep both low-maintenance and honest, and the thrifted leather is non-negotiable.

results.title: That Girl
results.description: 5am alarm, iced green juice, the pilates routine and a journal full of goals. You turned self-improvement into an aesthetic and then actually executed it — the matching set is cute, but the to-do list is the real religion.

results.title: Soft Girl
results.description: Blush tones, pastel nails, cute stationery and the instinct to make everyone feel included. You're the friend who brings snacks, remembers the details and makes ordinary days feel deliberately sweet.

results.title: Indie Sleaze
results.description: Flash photos, smudged eyeliner, last night's outfit and an ironic joke about all of it. You looked at a decade of curated perfection and chose messy, clever and fun — the party's better when you're running the chaos.

results.title: Barbiecore
results.description: Head-to-toe hot pink, maximalist joy and the social energy of someone born at the center of a group photo. You picked one color, turned it all the way up, and somehow make everyone around you feel like the main character too.
